== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Star Trek CCG champion from the great Northwest, Jason Drake of Seattle." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
